compare records
explain _lines=R1 weak=R2 none=R3
requirement R1 One output line per key, in input order: `weak <label> <d>` or `none <label>`
requirement R2 A key whose d is between 1 and the bound is reported with that d (d = 1 means the key is G itself; d = 2 needs doubling)
requirement R3 Only an exact match is weak: the bound is inclusive (d = bound + 1 is `none`), and both coordinates must match, so the negated key (x, p - y) is `none`
requirement R4 Both curves work: P-256 and P-384 each use their own prime and generator
requirement R5 A bound of 1000 with several keys finishes in time, including keys that are not weak
requirement E2E The weak values reported for the real incident, mixed with strong keys
